about.text: Baked milk is a variety of boiled milk that has been particularly popular in Russia, Ukraine and Belarus. It is made by simmering milk on low heat for eight hours or longer.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Milk is kept hot for hours, far longer than for pasteurising, so it browns and boils down a little without being cooked to a skin. Traditionally it stood in a Russian stove; dairies now hold it in closed, stirred tanks.
